newsitem.title: USA: Senate votes to extend US SPR sales authority a yr.
newsitem.headline: Senate votes to extend US SPR sales authority a yr.

text.p: The Senate Saturday voted to extend for a year the president's authority to sell oil from the Strategic Petroleum Reserve in an energy emergency.

The House earlier passed a similar version of the bill, which extends the oil sale authority through Sept 30, 1997. The Senate action was taken by voice vote in a rare Saturday session. The differing bills must be reconciled before being sent to President Clinton for signing into law.

The measure has no provisions expanding the president's authority to use the preserve to prevent an energy crisis as some Northeastern lawmakers have suggested might be necessary to avert price spikes in the heating oil market this winter.
